governance.attested_by: ercot42 wtx-curtailment-driver keeper-promotion gate session 2026-07-07 (full scored bundle; owner promotion sign-off PENDING)
governance.note: WP-B West Texas Export corridor VRE curtailment-share driver on the ercot34 keeper recipe, single delta ercot_wtx_curtailment_driver=True (docs/handoffs/ercot-vre-curtailment-wpb-driver-2026-07.md). SHAPE = measured NP6-86 SCED West-corridor binding frequency binned by within-year net-load decile x hour x season, geo-attributed via the authoritative ERCOT Settlement-Point/electrical-bus mapping (NP4-160, LZ_WEST precision 1.00); never fit to the [3e] curtailment volume or any price residual; LOYO-reproduces the binding-frequency distribution. LEVEL = one per-tech depth coefficient (wind 0.0998 / solar 0.1633) converting congestion incidence into curtailed fraction, centred on the measured curtailment MW quantity (HSL - delivered) exactly like the RTOLCAP-forward deliv coefficient; LOYO-stable 0.0984-0.0998 (wind). OWNER RULING 2026-07-07: the depth coefficient is ACCEPTED as defensible and logged as a documented ASSUMPTION, not a disqualifying caveat - external precedent is mainstream (NREL ReEDS, Cambium, EIA NEMS, Aurora, EPA IPM all use reduced-form historically/simulation-calibrated curtailment representations for sub-zonal congestion); this construction is more disciplined (measured shape + one LOYO-stable scalar, not a free derate). Zero-forcing ablation twin (depth=0) registered alongside and reproduces the keeper byte-faithfully - all movement is the measured driver. DOCUMENTED ASSUMPTIONS (forecast leg, handoff §8): (1) the within-year net-load percentile axis normalizes away the absolute year-over-year congestion rise - it re-composes which hours are congested but pins decile-conditional depth at the 2023-25 level, so congestion DEPTH under-escalates at deep penetration (conservative); (2) share/depth encode the 2023-25 West-corridor network topology - future Permian/CREZ transmission builds would ease the congestion and the driver does not auto-relax (no speculative transmission-additions scaler is fitted). Applied only where the year carries an uncurtailed potential basis (measured HSL in backcast; reference-rate gross-up in forecast) - no double-curtailment. Everything else is the ercot34 stack unchanged, including its inherited fitted surface (no scalar re-tuned; this run adds the two entries below).
